content.title: Why ArcBest (ARCB) Stock Is Up Today
content.summary: Shares of freight Delivery Company ArcBest (NASDAQ:ARCB) jumped 4.2% in the morning session after Citigroup upgraded the company's stock rating to Buy from Neutral. This action signaled increased confidence in the stock's potential performance.
